I'm laying out the graph structure with nodes and their connecting edges and weights, mapping out the coordinates and distances between them to understand the network topology.

Running Kruskal's algorithm, I sort edges by weight and pick them greedily while tracking connected components, ending up with a 6-edge minimum spanning tree connecting all 7 nodes without creating cycles.

Now I'm defining the corridor coordinates for each selected edge, specifying the row/column ranges that connect each pair of nodes in the tree.
